title: Explicit target-only calibration policies
scope: Engineering implementation and local behavioral verification; ISB model-by-model parity remains Phase 6 and PXD Moments parity remains Phase 7.

policies.refit_with_locked_window: Retain the dataset-local +entrapment window, refit nuisance parameters in the target-only candidate space, and never tune the window from target-only outcomes.
policies.reuse_dataset_artifact: Reuse the complete same-dataset +entrapment fitted artifact without refitting nuisance state.
policies.compare_both: Materialize both interpretations separately; refit is the release candidate and reuse is retained as diagnostic evidence.

implemented_safeguards: Workflow-wide policy with optional model-specific override
Explicit target-only stage names and separate output directories
Separate locked-window provenance and fitted nuisance-state provenance
Fail-closed dataset, model, search-configuration, candidate-fingerprint, and stable-ID-schema checks for dataset-local artifact reuse
Candidate-population provenance for each locked Ensemble expert
Fresh target-FASTA candidate search for the first target-only interpretation
Exact immutable target candidate-pool reuse for the second compare_both interpretation
Policy-specific MS2Rescore annotation fingerprints remain fail-closed
Legacy target_only validation rows map to refit_with_locked_window for parity
Diagnostic compare_both reuse rows cannot veto release transfer or TDC gates
behavioral_tests: Default policy and compare_both release/diagnostic expansion
Separate compare_both target stage records, provenance, modes, and paths
Forced fresh candidate search followed by compatible-pool reuse
Artifact rejection on source candidate-population mismatch
Ensemble window-only refit versus complete artifact reuse
Separate transfer evidence for both policies
Legacy target-only parity selects refit semantics only
